title: Only a paying account takes money: a free member takes no tips, and a free Space takes donations only when its owner pays for Crew

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18, 9:15 to 9:18 PM PT (project thread: Rethink our take rates): "The only time you can process money, is if you are paying money." "If a Crew member starts a free space, they can take donations." Decision card "Choose who can take tips under the paying-only rule": "Paid Spaces and Crew members". ADR-1978 item 4. Pin rewrites approved by the owner 2026-11-18 ("Yes, all groups in the doc"). Decision card "Count beta Crew as paying", relayed by the coordinator 2026-11-18 9:29 PM PT.

detail: Tips were open to every member with a payout account, whatever they paid, and a donation needed a Space on Business even when its owner paid for Crew. DONE 2026-11-19: lib/pricing/paying-accounts.ts is the one rule. A tip is refused (lib/billing/tips.ts) and its button hidden (the profile page and the Spotlight tip jar, lib/spotlight/data.ts) unless the recipient pays for Crew or owns a Space whose plan takes payments. A donation opens (lib/billing/space-donation-checkout.ts, both the checkout and the card that decides whether to show a button) on a paying plan, or on a free Space whose owner pays for Crew. Every other sale still goes through the payments gate at the Business floor, so a Crew owner's free Space sells nothing else. Paying for Crew is read from the billed column profiles.membership_tier, never the beta grant and never a Crew granted by a community membership. One exception, by the owner's decision card ("Count beta Crew as paying", 2026-11-18): while the beta is open the Crew every member is granted counts as paying, so tips and a free Space's donations stay open through January 31, 2027, and the exception ends by itself at the end of that day Pacific. The payments gate is untouched, so a free Space sells nothing during the beta either. The Space payments page and the upgrade panel no longer promise tips to a free Space. Known limit: only the first 12 Spaces a person owns are checked for a paying plan. Marketing and help copy that still says tips are open on every plan follows in the copy rows.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
